title: Read-only GitHub integration
description: GitHub feature scope and design constraints.
body: Read-only, and that is a scope decision rather than a stage: nothing here comments, merges, or opens anything on GitHub. Everything is one-shot request→reply, because there is nothing to watch. The region re-asks when the cluster changes and when a person presses refresh. The UI vocabulary is adapted from Orca: one list holding both issues and pull requests, keyed on a kind tag, filtered by is: qualifiers.
